headline: Park fee credits and refunds, a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park, and fields and pavilions for flag football and a party.
summary: Requests include fee credits for four rained-out dates and a refund for a canceled event. Other items cover rentals at Gage Field, South Common, and Shedd Park, plus a request to convert Finn Field.
items: Sabeeh Ehsan: fee credits for rain-outs on September 13th ($100), September 20 ($75), September 26 ($50), and September 27 ($100)
Ava Spies: permission to start a Free Little Pantry at Fort Hill Park
Catherine Apollo: refund request for the canceled September 26th event
Joseph Bova: adult flag football at Gage Field I and II, Sunday November 29, 2026, 10am-2pm, total $100
Larry Benjamin: flag football tournament at South Common, Purtell Multipurpose Field, Friday November 27, 2026, 9am-5pm, total $225, 100 people max
Hamim Hasan: fundraiser for LHS at Shedd Park Pavilion, Sunday November 8, 2026, 12pm-4pm, total fee $200
Joe Cady: cancel bike races and waive the unpaid fee on his account
Adrianna Paquin: birthday party at Shedd Park Pavilion, Sunday November 29, 2026, 1pm-5pm, total fee $200
Matt LeLacheur (LYBSL): donate renovation costs at McNamara Field, and convert Finn Field to a multipurpose field for baseball and softball
location: Mayor’s Reception Room, 375 Merrimack St. 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852

2.) Ava Spies – Community Food Pantry 
Fort Hill Park  
Hoping to gain permission to start up a Free Little Pantry in the Rogers Fort Hill / 
 Belvidere area of Lowell. The project would be a small structure where community 
 members can take what they need / give what they can, including pantry food items and 
 other household necessities.
